events.title: Taiwan holds nine-in-one local elections across the island alongside a nationwide referendum on adopting nuclear power
Voters in Switzerland decide in federal popular votes on increasing VAT to fund OASI pensions and on restricting fireworks
Australian state of Victoria holds general elections for the Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council
European Central Bank and the Eurosystem deploy the November 2026 TARGET Services release across European market infrastructures
Leaders of Southeast Asian nations meet in Hanoi, Vietnam, for the 11th Ayeyawady–Chao Phraya–Mekong Economic Cooperation Strategy (ACMECS) Summit
Germany's BSW party concludes its 4th federal party congress (Bundesparteitag) at Messe Dresden
South Africa holds a Category 2 State Funeral with military honours for former Deputy President Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka
Albania's opposition Democratic Party and students stage an anti-government protest outside the Ministry of Education demanding the cabinet's resignation
Nationwide marches and public sector strike notices called by Grève Féministe and CGT take place in Paris and across France against gender-based violence
Deadline expires at midnight for French primary school teachers to declare their intention to join the December 1 public sector strike
German trade union federation DGB NRW and IG Metall hold a major Ruhr region demonstration in Bochum over welfare, pensions, and industrial policy
Education unions ver.di and GEW lead a protest march in Hamburg against planned senate budget cuts to schools for 2027/2028
Prague Castle opens its normally inaccessible state halls and presidential reception rooms to the public for an Advent open day
Prague opens its main Christmas markets and lights the Christmas tree on Old Town Square and Wenceslas Square
Správa železnic halts train traffic on the main railway corridor 010 between Zámrsk and Choceň for overhead line repairs, replacing regional trains with buses
Správa železnic begins a two-week railway closure on line 017 between Česká Třebová, Moravská Třebová, and Dzbel for ETCS signalling installation
Prague Public Transit Company (DPP) launches its illuminated Christmas fleet with a ceremonial parade from the Střešovice depot
Community of Discalced Carmelite nuns formally seals the papal enclosure of its newly built monastery in Drasty near Prague
National student science conference Zvaž vědu! holds its main panel debate on the future of Czech science at the University of West Bohemia in Plzeň
Prague secondary school education fair Schola Pragensis concludes its final day at the Prague Congress Centre
Chamber of Tax Advisers of the Czech Republic (KDP ČR) holds its autumn qualification exam evaluation seminar in Prague
Evangelical State Synod of Württemberg concludes its autumn session in Stuttgart after voting on the 2027/2028 church budget and abuse inquiry reports
Election officials in South Goa District, India, conclude First Level Checking of Electronic Voting Machines ahead of the 2027 Goa Assembly polls
Trade union federation COSATU concludes the three-day Southern African LGBTIQ+ Workers and Allies Workshop in Johannesburg
Elections Commission of Maldives conducts a Local Council By-Election
Taiwan holds nationwide local elections, including mayoral races in Taipei and five other major cities.
The International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea delivers its order in Hamburg on Argentina’s request to block work on the Sea Lion oil project near the Falkland Islands.
Taiwan votes in a national referendum on whether to scrap its nuclear-free energy policy.
Australia’s Victoria elects both houses of its state parliament.
Spain observes a campaign-silence day ahead of its snap general election on November 29.
The Eurosystem rolls out upgrades to its TARGET payment, securities settlement and collateral systems.
A new ramp from the D2 arriving from Bratislava onto the Ostrava-bound D1 is due to open at the Brno-jih motorway interchange.
The EU’s EUDAMED registration deadline falls for medical devices covered by the database’s transitional provisions.
SpaceX targets a Falcon 9 launch from California’s Vandenberg Space Force Base for the U.S. Space Force’s USSF-380 mission.
Unions and feminist groups mobilize across France against sexual and gender-based violence.
Italy’s CISL union rallies at the port of Gioia Tauro, drawing workers from five southern regions as part of its national jobs and development campaign.
IG Metall stages a Ruhr industrial workers’ march and rally in Bochum.
Prague Castle opens the president’s normally restricted state rooms to the public.
The Scottish Trades Union Congress leads an anti-racism and anti-fascism march and rally in Glasgow.
Unions at Venice’s La Fenice opera house are scheduled to strike.
Kuwait City’s NEXUS technology and startup summit wraps up with the Kuwait Innovates hackathon.
Accra hosts the Ghana–Japan Trade & Industry Expo, focused on trade and investment between Africa and Asia.
An overnight lane restriction on the Prague Ring Road toward the D1 is due to end after work to expand capacity.
The Czech Gastroenterological Society’s national meeting concludes in Karlovy Vary.
Prague hosts the ZDrSEM first-aid conference, with sessions on the Záchranka emergency app, prehospital burn care and workplace first aid.
Metropolitan University Prague and the Association for International Affairs hold a public briefing on what the U.S. midterms mean for Trump’s foreign policy.
A Czech–Polish contemporary art exhibition opens at the Nová Perla gallery in Krásná Lípa.
Italian filmmaker Salvatore Mereu presents his film Alberi erranti at Prague’s MittellCinemaFest and takes questions after the screening.
Taiwan holds nine-in-one local elections and a national referendum on nuclear power and ending the nuclear-free homeland policy
Spain observes the legal day of reflection ahead of Sunday’s snap general election; campaigning and election polls stay banned
ITLOS delivers its order on provisional measures in Argentina v. United Kingdom over hydrocarbon exploitation in the South-West Atlantic
Algeria votes in local elections for municipal and wilaya assemblies
SpaceX targets a Falcon 9 launch of the classified USSF-380 mission from Vandenberg, window opening at 8:39 p.m. PT
South Sudan’s voter-registration period for the planned general election closes
Marches against gender-based violence in Paris, from the Panthéon at 14:00, and across France
First phase of Spain’s nationwide public-doctors’ strike, called by Sindicato Médicos Unidos, ends at 08:00
First Bus drivers in York strike over pay, with a limited network planned
Saerco air-traffic controllers’ open-ended strike continues at Canary Islands airports, with minimum services set through 30 November
Make Amazon Pay actions by Amazon workers and unions continue across countries through 30 November
Chilean unions march in Santiago against the AFP pension system, meeting at Plaza Italia
Sber’s AI Journey conference continues in Moscow through its final day
Czech fuel-price caps stay in force over the weekend at Friday’s ceilings; the November regulation runs through 30 November and non-working days use the last announced price
Prague Castle opens normally closed state rooms to the public for its Advent open day, last entry 16:30
Prague public-transport company DPP lights its Christmas vehicle fleet at the Střešovice transport museum and sends a parade through the centre
